messages:
infra-bot: PAGE: high-error-rate on eu-west-1-gpu-pool-3 · queue growth = 12k reqs · thrashing detected (driver Xid + node flaps) :rotating_light:

carla_oncall: I’m on it. Seeing steady increase in pending queue, autoscaler hasn't increased desired for last 7m. Starting handoff to oncall runbook.

carla_oncall: quick check — is this just one pool? dashboard: https://console.redwood/internal/dashboards/gpu-pools?pool=eu-west-1-gpu-pool-3

dave_sre: pinging infra team. Node flaps + CUDA Xid spikes across 3 hosts (gw-03, gw-07, gw-11). CPU mostly fine, GPU mem OOMs ramping.

frank_eng: seeing repeated kernel log lines on gw-07: ```[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 31, PID=2345 in process python``` — looks like runtime/kernel driver combo OOMing sessions and triggering evict.

emily_prod: any customer-facing impact? Support dashboard shows 18 customer sessions degraded, 2 timeouts. Support ticket queue rising.

gina_support: escalating to priority — two accounts (ACME and NovaHealth) reporting 5xxs in EU region. Notifications sent.

carla_oncall: immediate mitigation plan: 1) throttle new queued requests for eu-west region (soft 429 at edge) 2) mark suspect nodes for drain + cordon 3) apply driver hotpatch to remaining hosts if stable 4) fallback routing to eu-west-2 and us-central for critical customers.

ben_infra: throttling rule pushed to ingress: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood/edge/rate-limits -d '{"region":"eu-west-1","limit":"200r/s","scope":"pool-3"}'``` — will give autoscaler breathing room.

opsbot: ACTION: ingress rate limit applied. New requests will receive 429 when queue > 8k.

carla_oncall: cordoning gw-07 and gw-11 now. Draining in progress. ```kubectl cordon gw-07 && kubectl drain gw-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data```

frank_eng: while draining, we observed driver module crashing on unload then not coming back on gw-11. Suggest pinning driver to previous stable revision on drained hosts then rolling a controlled hotpatch across remaining healthy nodes.

dave_sre: Autoscaler logs: ```scale_decision: desired=6 current=6 pending_queue=11234 reason=driver_unavailable``` — autoscaler refused to create more because node templates failing health checks. Need to relax health check gating for a limited window OR provision warm spare nodes.

carla_oncall: I'm going to temporarily allow warm-spares for 15m to add capacity, and set autoscale safety to bypass health-check for new instances: ```/infra/autoscaler set bypass_health_check=true ttl=15m``` — will monitor.

frank_eng: prepping driver hotpatch v2.3.1-hotp where we revert a kernel param and add more conservative CUDA claimant limits. Rolling to 3 nodes at a time. Patch tested on gw-02 with no Xid in 20m.

emily_prod: routing change for critical customers: failover to eu-west-2 for NovaHealth and ACME. Notifying customers now with ETA 15-30m.

gina_support: confirmed notifications dispatched: "We’re mitigating an infrastructure issue affecting EU inference. Traffic will be routed to alternate regions; performance may vary. We'll follow up."

carla_oncall: status update 10m: queue down from 12k -> 7.5k after throttling + warm spares. Two nodes drained, 4 new warm spares coming up. Driver hotpatch started on gw-02, gw-04, gw-06.

dave_sre: monitoring metrics: GPU memory OOMs dropping on patched hosts. Xid events reduced from 28/min -> 3/min on gw-02. Still seeing occasional flaps on older nodes.

opsbot: INCIDENT NOTE: pager handled by carla_oncall -> handoff to dave_sre at 2155003000 for 2h watch.

carla_oncall: handing off. I'll remain available but passing primary to dave. Key actions: finish hotpatch roll, verify autoscaler stability, confirm no new 5xx tickets.

dave_sre: acknowledged. I'll keep traces open and update every 15m. Next check at +15.

frank_eng: rolling patch completed across pool-3 (batch size 3). No new Xid on patched nodes for 12m. We'll schedule a follow-up kernel driver upgrade with vendor next week.

emily_prod: customer impact summary for postmortem: ~30k requests affected over 40m window, 2 named customers with degraded experience, temporary regional failover for those accounts, no data loss. Drafting customer comms.

gina_support: support tickets: 29 created, 6 escalated. Triage notes attached to incident ticket #INC-2155001234.

dave_sre: closing loop — queue steady at ~1.2k, autoscaler resumed normal ops, warm-spares autoscale flag reverted. Will monitor for 2h then declare recovered.

carla_oncall: recovered verdict in 2h if stable. Thanks all for quick ops. :clap: 

opsbot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: state=mitigated · duration=01:05:26 · lead=carla_oncall · handoff_to=dave_sre

emily_prod: assigning postmortem owner frank_eng. Please include root cause (driver/runtime combo), timelines, customer impact, and recommended infra mitigations (health-check policy changes, warm-spare runbook, automated hotpatch test harness).

frank_eng: will own postmortem. I'll include logs, kernel traces, and the hotpatch rollout notes.

carla_oncall: final note: keep alert thresholds on queue growth tighter and add an alert for autoscaler stuck decisions. Suggested alert: `pending_queue > 5k && desired == current && error_rate > 5%`

dave_sre: ack. Adding alert to grafana and pager duty.

infra-bot: ticket INC-2155001234 updated with timeline and actions.
